name: AboveWP Min Max Quantity
author: AboveWP

sections.description:
AboveWP Min Max Quantity allows you to set minimum and maximum quantity limits for your WooCommerce products. This helps you control how many items customers can purchase at once.

Features

  • Set minimum quantity requirements for products
  • Set maximum quantity limits for products
  • Automatic validation when adding to cart
  • User-friendly admin interface
  • Dark mode support
  • Seamless integration with AboveWP ecosystem

How to Use

  1. Go to any WooCommerce product edit page
  2. Scroll down to the “Product Data” section
  3. Find the “Minimum Quantity” and “Maximum Quantity” fields
  4. Enter your desired values and save the product
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/abovewp-min-max-quantity directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Use the Settings->Min Max Quantity screen to configure the plugin
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with variable products?

Yes, the plugin works with both simple and variable products.

Can I set different limits for different variations?

Currently, the plugin only supports setting limits at the product level. Variation-specific limits may be added in a future version.
